card.name: Basal before insulin; HUMALOG and U-strengths
card.fires_on: The word "basal" just before "insulin" in insulin dosing text. It also fires on the "UM" inside HUMALOG and on "U" in strengths like U-200.

modes.label: U-strength
modes.description: The letter U in insulin strengths such as U-200.
